'''Chomm''' was a [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] criminal who lived on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="TOR" /> In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> he visited the [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] of [[Tookreek]], a [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] in the [[Diago Hixan's gang|gang]] of [[Diago Hixan]]. Tookreek planned to send Chomm to retrieve a [[Krayt dragon/Legends|krayt dragon]] fang that Diago's lieutenants needed to possess to be able to meet with the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]].<ref name="TOR" />

However, Chomm attempted to threaten [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Nariel Pridence]] into leaving [[Tookreek's Cantina]], unaware she was a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. Despite Pridence's attempts to defuse the situation, Chomm and his men [[Skirmish in Tookreek's Cantina|attacked]] her and were [[Death/Legends|killed]].<ref name="TOR" />
